scope: All 19 prior flags, 4 medicine proposals, 14 reviewed nebulizer accessories, related Hyclens and cotton product lines, and selected literal subtype conflicts.
plan: Inspect repository definitions and prior review inputs
Verify targeted source-specific matches with primary sources and cached documentary page images
Write implementable correction/retain/hold evidence without editingCSV or approvals

impact.data_analytics: Classification evidence only; no historical financial/source/quantity changes
impact.security: No secrets or authenticated cloud writes
impact.operations: No services stopped or builds run
